description:
Featured in this lot is a selection of fine vintage silver drinkware centered around a solid sterling silver cup by International Sterling. Stamped "Sterling K95" on the bottom, the cup measures 3" in diameter by 2.5" tall and exhibits minor surface dents consistent with age and use.
-Accompanying the sterling cup is a matching set of 11 vintage silver-plated goblets marked "International Silver Company" on the base.
-Each goblet measures 3" in diameter by 6" tall, offering a classic aesthetic for dining or collection.
- Formed in Meriden, Connecticut in 1898, ISC brought together many independent historical silver manufacturers under one massive corporate umbrella.
-They became a dominant force in mid-century American tableware and produced these specific plain-walled, smooth-stemmed goblet styles in large numbers during the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s.
-Note: Winning bidder should bring boxes and packing for your treasures!

description: This lot includes a large assortment of collectible minerals, fossils, gemstones, and decorative items. Two boxed collections labeled 'Collection des Mineraux' and 'Collection des Fossiles' feature identified specimens such as quartz, calcite, amethyst, ammonite, and shark tooth. Items are in good collectible condition with minor wear from handling and age. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology and natural history enthusiasts.

description:
Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators
This set includes three vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.
